sources.snapshotRule: freeze official XLSX in immutable REF and record SHA-256
sources.validation: FAIL_CLOSED: SP + Total + 2026; ages 0..89 plus 90+; age sum must equal declared Total when present

model.open90Plus: geometric decay derived from population age 89 / age 88 in the same frozen workbook; no external demographic parameter

notes: The synthetic generator consumes the immutable daily reference and has no runtime IBGE/SIDRA dependency.

Uniform day allocation is a deterministic synthetic-data convention.
